problem: The projection of the intersection between the hyperboloid of two sheets $\frac{(x-1)^{2}}{20}+\frac{(y-2)^{2}}{16}-\frac{{z}^{2}}{80}=-1$ and the plane $y=4$ onto the $xz$-plane is a hyperbola. What are the lengths of the semi-axes of the hyperbola?

feedback.problem: What is the trace in the $yz$-plane of the hyperboloid of one sheet $\frac{{x}^{2}}{2}+\frac{{y}^{2}}{5}-\frac{{z}^{2}}{3}=1?$
feedback.worked_solution:
To find the trace in the $yz$-plane, we substitute $x=0$ into the equation of the hyperboloid:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{(0)^{2}}{2}+\frac{{y}^{2}}{5}-\frac{{z}^{2}}{3}=1 \\ \frac{{y}^{2}}{5}-\frac{{z}^{2}}{3}=1\end{aligned}
$$

This gives us the equation of the hyperbola in $yz$-plane.
